title: Exact counting of unlabeled quartic graphs by permutation-cycle aggregation
summary: The number of unlabeled regular graphs can be expressed as an average of fixed-point counts over vertex permutations, but evaluating each fixed-point count still requires the degree constraints to be enforced. We give an exact recurrence that processes one complete permutation cycle at a time and records the remaining cycles only by their lengths and residual degrees. The recurrence combines internal edge orbits with orbits joining distinct cycles, while binomial and multinomial coefficients retain the multiplicities of choices that lead to the same remaining state.
